data.name: ShadowVerse
data.description: Agentic AI that turns real user session recordings into demographic digital twins, fine-tuned with Mistral, that autonomously test web apps the way real users would. Built at the Mistral AI hackathon.
data.title: ShadowVerse

metric.label: PostHog session events, clustered into 3 user types with one fine-tuned Mistral model each

data.name: hpml-final-project
data.description: Extends IBM AssetOpsBench with a vision inspection agent, then applies AWQ INT4 quantization to the Qwen2.5-VL and Llama 3 LLaVA VLMs for about 2x lower latency and far less GPU memory.
data.title: Multi-Modal Agent Inference Optimization

metric.label: lower end-to-end latency with INT4 on a single L4 GPU

data.name: pramana-care-ai
data.description: An agentic data-quality engine for Indian healthcare. It scores a 10,000-row facility dataset against contradiction rules and runs a LangGraph agent over Databricks and Mosaic AI Vector Search to answer planner questions with row-level citations. Built for the Hack-Nation Global AI Hackathon.
data.title: Pramana

data.name: agentic-music-recommender
data.description: An agentic RAG music recommender over 114K Spotify tracks. A LangGraph agent retrieves candidates, detects and corrects popularity and genre bias, and self-critiques its picks with confidence scoring.
data.title: SoundScout AI

metric.label: Spotify tracks in the retrieval index

data.name: dl4cv-final-project
data.description: A computer vision pipeline that maps retail shelves. It detects products with RT-DETR and YOLO, classifies them with CLIP visual anchors, and builds a spatial and semantic scene graph of product placement, like Coke next to Pepsi. Final project for Columbia Deep Learning for Computer Vision (COMS 4995).
data.title: Retail Shelf Scene Graphs

metric.label: mAP@50 for fine-tuned YOLOv11 on 2,920 SKU-110K test images, with 98.97% brand accuracy from CLIP visual anchors

data.name: arm-firstflight-infer-lab
data.description: A benchmark harness that finds which Arm optimization actually speeds up llama.cpp inference. It measures each optimization separately against a true unoptimized baseline on Azure Cobalt 100. ggml's own repack delivers the 3.60x speedup at Q4_0 with KleidiAI adding nothing on top, while KleidiAI earns 1.23x at Q8_0. Built for the Arm Create: AI Optimization Challenge.
data.title: Arm FirstFlight Attribution Ladder

metric.label: faster llama.cpp prompt processing on Arm at 1K tokens, with each gain traced to the optimization behind it

data.name: netflix-clone
data.title: NetClone
data.description: A local Netflix clone with a full data and ML stack: an ETL pipeline into a star-schema warehouse, a DuckDB lakehouse, Kafka-style event streaming, a hybrid recommender with a learned ranker, semantic search, and adaptive HLS video streaming with accounts and profiles.

metric.label: NDCG@10 on held-out viewing for the hybrid recommender, 25% above a popularity baseline

data.name: ai-news-analysis-raise-hackathon2026
data.description: RAISE 2026 hackathon project analyzing how AI is framed in news headlines. It enriches headlines with sentiment, emotion and topic clusters, and adds a custom AI-Phobia score (a fear lexicon plus a transformer emotion classifier) to catch alarmist framing that plain sentiment misses.
data.title: AI News Framing Analysis

data.name: active-clinical-guardian-devfest26
data.description: A real-time clinical safety monitor built at Columbia DevFest 2026. It listens to doctor-patient encounters, checks drug safety with AI reasoning, and interrupts by voice when it detects a dangerous interaction.
data.title: The Active Clinical Guardian

data.name: CC-F25 · Apartment Booking Platform
data.description: An apartment booking platform made of microservices on Google Cloud, a team project for Columbia's Cloud Computing course. I built the users service (Google Sign-In, JWT auth, Pub/Sub events), the bookings composite service that fetches user and listing data in parallel, and most of the frontend. FastAPI on Cloud Run with Cloud SQL.
data.title: Apartment Booking Platform

data.name: mistral-nemo-finetuning
data.description: The model training behind ShadowVerse, built at the Mistral Worldwide Hackathon. QLoRA-tunes Mistral Nemo 12B with Unsloth and TRL to turn a website description and a user profile into a JSON browsing policy that a Playwright + AgentQL agent executes. Tracked with Weights & Biases.
data.title: ShadowVerse Fine-Tuning

data.name: arena-caiac-fellowship
data.title: ARENA AI Safety Curriculum
data.description: My solutions to ARENA (Alignment Research Engineer Accelerator) for the Columbia AI Alignment Club's Advanced Technical Fellowship, Fall 2026. Ongoing. So far: the fundamentals chapter, from PyTorch basics to CNNs and ResNets, optimizers, and backprop built from scratch.

data.name: llms-related
data.description: Hands-on notebooks from DeepLearning.AI short courses on building with LLMs: agentic and advanced RAG (LlamaIndex, TruEra), vector databases (Pinecone), knowledge graphs for RAG (Neo4j), multimodal RAG, Llama 3.2, LLM pretraining, embeddings, database agents and prompt engineering.
data.title: LLM Course Notebooks

data.name: ml-dl-related
data.description: Deep learning experiments: intro CUDA and neural network notebooks from NVIDIA, an RNN on the IMDB reviews dataset, custom YOLOv4 training for goat detection, and a Hugging Face text-to-image app.
data.title: Deep Learning Experiments

data.name: databricks-related
data.description: Databricks notebooks for a text-to-SQL database agent built with LangChain, which turns natural-language questions into SQL queries.
data.title: Databricks Text-to-SQL Agent

data.name: neo4j-related
data.description: Graph database work in Neo4j: notes from the Neo4j GraphAcademy courses (Cypher, graph data modeling, CSV import, Python apps, Graph Data Science) and notebooks for a Northwind recommendation engine and a graph of programming languages.
data.title: Neo4j Graph Projects

data.name: opencv-programs
data.description: Notebooks and scripts from the OpenCV Bootcamp: image manipulation, annotation and enhancement, camera and video capture, filtering, edge detection and image alignment.
data.title: OpenCV Programs

data.name: Stock-Prediction-Web-App
data.description: A Streamlit app that forecasts stock prices up to 10 years ahead. It pulls price history with yfinance, fits a Facebook Prophet model on closing prices and shows the forecast in interactive Plotly charts.
data.title: Stock Prediction Web App

data.name: Spotify-Match
data.description: A React Native app that matches people by music taste. It connects to a user's Spotify account, analyzes their listening and suggests like-minded people and new music, with an Express.js and PostgreSQL backend on AWS. Built in Scrum sprints for UCSC's CSE 115A.
data.title: Spotify Match
